subject: Blender BONE Parenting
object: Object origin placed at bone TAIL not HEAD. Always offset by bone.head_local - bone.tail_local

subject: Blender ARMATURE_AUTO
object: Deformable body meshes. NEVER for rigid accessories (sword/shield/helmet) — they warp and fly off

subject: Blender matrix_parent_inverse
object: bpy.ops.object.parent_set operator BUT NOT by direct property assignment (obj.parent_type='BONE')

subject: DenizenReveal Component

subject: Professional 3D Character Pipeline
object: Separate mesh parts (body/sword/shield), proper UV unwraps, pre-made skeleton, weight painting, PBR materials

subject: Why AI Cannot Match Professional 3D Artist
object: No real-time visual feedback, must iterate via blind code->render->inspect cycle, and tends to make 20 changes at once instead of one-at-a-time debugging

subject: Knight Animation Attempt 7
object: Playwright + Three.js pose editor. Knight D Pelegrini Mixamo model (198 bones), 51 FBX clips, runtime texture repaint (steel plate + gold inlay), quaternion-space keyframe overrides. Result: Aurelith v4 WebM.

subject: Knight Animation Attempt 8
object: MoMask (CVPR 2024) text-to-motion diffusion. SMPL→Mixamo retarget. Fine-tuned on 25 knight combat samples. Batch pipeline for all 8 planes. ~45s per plane on RTX 4000.

subject: Knight Texture Repaint
object: Runtime canvas pixel manipulation in materials.js repaintTextureAtlas(). Detects red/brown/skin by RGB thresholds, replaces with steel plate colors. Adds gold inlay filigree lines at specific UV coordinates.

subject: Three.js Mixer Quaternion Bug
object: AnimationMixer's PropertyBinding writes directly to bone.quaternion._x/_y/_z/_w, bypassing the Euler↔Quaternion onChange sync. After mixer runs, bone.rotation reads stale values. bone.rotation.set() appears to work but reads back garbage.

subject: Three.js Mixer Quaternion Bug
object: Quaternion-space overrides: capture bone.quaternion after Euler set (while mixer stopped), store as keyframes, then apply via bone.quaternion.copy(slerp(...)) while mixer runs. Never use Euler after mixer.

subject: MoMask Fine-tuning
object: VQ-VAE: 50 epochs, loss 1.32→0.007. Transformer: 30 epochs, loss 9.63→4.39. Dataset: 25 samples (5 beats × 5 HumanML3D-style captions). Checkpoints at tools/momask/checkpoints/t2m_finetuned/.

subject: HumanML3D Prompt Engineering
object: Use body-part-specific physical descriptions matching mocap annotation style. 'a person swings their right arm in a wide arc from right to left' NOT 'a knight slashes'. Subject always 'a person'.
